# Vocal U A Cappella

> Official website of Vocal U, a gender-inclusive a cappella group at the University of Minnesota in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

Vocal U was founded in 2011. The group performs at university, charity, and community events in the Twin Cities.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.vocalu.org/): Overview and current highlights.
- [About](https://www.vocalu.org/about): Mission and repertoire.
- [Members](https://www.vocalu.org/members): Current singers by vocal part.
- [Events](https://www.vocalu.org/events): Current and past performances.
- [Media](https://www.vocalu.org/media): Performances and social media.
- [Auditions](https://www.vocalu.org/auditions): Current audition information.
- [Contact](https://www.vocalu.org/contact): Booking and general inquiries.
- [Support](https://www.vocalu.org/donate): Donation options.

For current dates and roster details, use the linked pages. Contact: vocalu@umn.edu.
